Apple Support says watchOS 10.4 includes bug fixes and performance enhancements.
According to this YouTube video, watchOS 10.4 includes improvements in notification syncing.
According to this YouTube video, watchOS 10.4 includes improvements in animation performance.
According to this YouTube video, watchOS 10.4 adds an average bedtime metric to the Sleep app.
Updating the Apple Watch using Settings on the watch requires watchOS 6 or later.
Apple Watch update requires the watch to be on its charger.
Apple Watch update requires the watch to be within range of the iPhone.
Apple Watch update requires the iPhone to be connected to Wi-Fi.
